opponents.name: Rocket Grunt Margot
opponents.meet_text: Did you know Team Rocket almost ruled the world? Anybody can be a Rocket member if they want.
opponents.repeat_text: Have you thought about joining us yet?
opponents.first_win_text: I'm supposed to be recruiting so take one of our uniforms if you want to join!
opponents.rematch_win_text: You've got everything it takes to join us.
opponents.loss_text: Maybe you're not cut out to be a Rocket grunt like me.

opponents.name: Rocket Exec Proton
opponents.meet_text: This well is bringing back a lot of memories... I can't imagine you've heard of Team Rocket before but you'll hear about us soon.
opponents.first_win_text: Heh we're in your shadow then huh.
opponents.rematch_win_text: It won't always be like this.

opponents.name: Rocket Exec Petrel
opponents.meet_text: Heh, you've found us at the right time. We've been hiding from the police... Not that we've done anything illegal, we're just here to play this card game.
opponents.rematch_win_text: You should join us, we've got big things coming.
opponents.loss_text: Of course you didn't stand a chance against us.

opponents.name: Rocket Exec Archer
opponents.meet_text: Hello. I'm Archer one of the 4 execs of Team Rocket. We're not here to do anything illicit. Not yet anyway. We're just getting started.
opponents.repeat_text: If you're really that interested you should join us.
opponents.first_win_text: Enjoy the wins while they last.

opponents.name: Rocket Exec Ariana
opponents.meet_text: Have you bought any of our card packs yet? Boss wants us to make as much money as possible as soon as we can.
opponents.repeat_text: You got one pack free but I won't be giving you another.
opponents.first_win_text: Here's a free one on me. Don't expect any more though.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Don't ask for anything from us.

opponents.name: Rocket Boss Giovanni
opponents.meet_text: Good evening. I believe we may have already met? I've been working tirelessly since I arrived. There seems to be a lot of money to be made in this card game.
opponents.repeat_text: Nice to see you again. I'm willing to play again.
opponents.first_win_text: Interesting. You've got a great technique.
opponents.rematch_win_text: You could teach me a thing or two about this.
opponents.loss_text: Hmm. I won't let you beat me.
